description: Defines the LifecycleManager class and its nested Notification class, including interface implementations, member variables, and method declarations for managing lifecycle events within a plugin framework.

classes.name: LifecycleManager
classes.description: Manages plugin lifecycle and state notifications, implements plugin interfaces, and maintains lifecycle state.

classes.name: LifecycleManager::Notification
classes.description: Handles remote connection notifications and app lifecycle state changes, forwarding events to the parent LifecycleManager.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin with the provided service.
